component.name: Rustle
component.summary: Native music player for NetEase Cloud Music and local libraries

description.p: Rustle is a native desktop music player built with Rust and iced. It supports NetEase Cloud Music streaming, local library import, persistent playback, system media controls, and GPU-accelerated lyrics rendering.
The app includes playlist management, folder watching for local music libraries, tray integration, and synchronized lyric formats such as LRC, YRC, QRC, TTML, and ESLrc.
